items.title: Add deterministic greeting API
items.goal: Add a small public greeting function while preserving existing normalization behavior.

acceptance.text: greet returns Hello plus the normalized non-blank input for varied generated names, including non-ASCII and punctuation cases.
greet rejects a blank or whitespace-only name with ValueError.

non_goals: Changing normalize_name behavior; that regression is protected by baseline probes.
CI, verification-probe, baseline-test, or authority-document changes.
